templates.r4Hand: Get Transcript File takes its Drive file from $json.docsDestination.document in URL mode, but its input is the Meet transcripts list reply (the document sits under transcripts[]), so n8n gets no file id whatever the data
the manual trigger also feeds the disabled Read Binary File and download nodes, which n8n passes through, so Read Spreadsheet File runs a second time on an item with no binary data and fails
